segments.name: Transportation and Logistics
segments.description: Transports crude oil by trucking and pipeline for producers and refiners across major U.S. producing basins.
segments.evidence: The transportation and logistics segment includes crude oil gathering and transportation assets, including pipeline and trucking operations in the Permian and Anadarko Basins.

segments.name: Terminaling and Storage Services
segments.description: Operates crude oil terminal facilities and pipeline injection stations that give producers takeaway capacity and storage.
segments.evidence: The terminaling and storage services segment consists of crude oil terminal facilities located in Colorado City, Texas and Delhi, Louisiana.

segments.name: Supply and Trading
segments.description: Purchases, aggregates, markets and resells crude oil, condensate and natural gas liquids for producers, refiners and end users.
segments.evidence: The supply and trading segment purchases and markets crude oil, condensate, and related hydrocarbon products.

revenueModel.text: Producers, marketers and refiners pay for crude oil transportation, terminaling and storage, and buyers pay for crude oil and related products resold under contract.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include leading producers, marketers, and refiners such as Marathon Oil Company, ConocoPhillips, Phillips 66, BP, Civitas, and Validus.

changes.text: In the third quarter of 2025, the company changed from two to three reportable segments by adding supply and trading.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Company now reports three operating segments: transportation and logistics, terminaling and storage services, and supply and trading.

changes.text: In July 2025, the company sold its Meridian Equipment Leasing and Equipment Transport water trucking businesses to Jorgan Development.
